dataset: NASA PCoE Composites (CFRP fatigue, PZT guided wave + X-ray)
notes: Legacy portal datasets.phl.pdx.edu is dead (NXDOMAIN 2026-10-03); S3 bucket is the current official host per NASA PCoE repository page.

files.integrity: zip testzip() clean; byte size matches HTTP Content-Length exactly

structure.pzt_config: two 6-PZT SMART Layers (Acellent): 6 actuators (1-6) + 6 sensors (7-12); 36 trajectories x 7 frequencies (150-450 kHz step 50) = 252 paths

signal.values: raw ADC-like counts stored as float32

known_gaps: L3S13, L3S14: no X-ray images, only hand-traced drawings
L1S18, L1S17: X-ray film photos only

provenance_docs: data/raw/nasa_cfrp/2. Composites/docs_extracted/ (README.pdf + 4 papers, identical across layups)

extracted_inventory_2026-10-04.note: counts case-insensitive; dir names vary (XRay/XRays, .jpg/.JPG, PZT-data/PZTdata)
